style.reference_volume: 第二卷：基础、理论和可信性

fonts.math: STIX mathtext (same as volume-two Matplotlib plots)

description: Four analytical teaching figures for the opening mathematics chapters.
vector_outputs: PDF embeds fonts; SVG uses vector glyph paths. Editable labels and all plotted geometry remain in plots.py.

language-minimum-infimum.kind: analytical teaching construction, not observed experimental data
language-minimum-infimum.reader_question: The same infimum need not be attained: endpoint membership is visible through hollow/filled markers.
language-minimum-infimum.formula: f(x)=x; X_open=(0,1), X_closed=[0,1]; both inf=0; closed argmin={0}, open argmin is empty.

parameters.endpoint_display: Line segments depict the graph closure; hollow markers exclude the endpoints in the open-domain panel.

language-minimum-infimum.processing: Direct evaluation; no smoothing or random sampling. Discontinuous pieces are drawn separately.

analysis-metric-convergence.kind: analytical teaching construction, not observed experimental data
analysis-metric-convergence.reader_question: Changing the metric can change convergence and continuity without changing the sequence values or the identity formula.
analysis-metric-convergence.chapter_source: 03-mathematical-analysis.tex: 度量空间与收敛、连续性与Lipschitz条件
analysis-metric-convergence.formula: x_n=1/n; d_u(x,y)=abs(x-y); d_d(x,y)=I{x!=y}. id:(R,d_u)->(R,d_d) is discontinuous at 0 since d_d(h,0)=1 for all h!=0.

parameters.identity_slice: h>=0; output distance at h=0 is 0, elsewhere it is 1

analysis-metric-convergence.processing: Direct evaluation; no smoothing or random sampling. Discontinuous pieces are drawn separately.

analysis-continuity-counterexamples.kind: analytical teaching construction, not observed experimental data
analysis-continuity-counterexamples.reader_question: Continuity preserves nearby outputs, a jump breaks this property, and continuity does not guarantee a common two-sided slope.
analysis-continuity-counterexamples.chapter_source: 03-mathematical-analysis.tex: 度量空间与收敛、连续性与Lipschitz条件、一元导数与局部变化率
analysis-continuity-counterexamples.formula: f1(x)=x^2: at x0=0, epsilon=1/4 and delta=1/2 imply |x|<delta -> |f1(x)|<epsilon. j(x)=0 for x<0, 1 for x>=0. f3(x)=|x|: continuous at 0; left/right derivatives=-1/+1.
analysis-continuity-counterexamples.processing: Direct evaluation; no smoothing or random sampling. Discontinuous pieces are drawn separately.

analysis-derivative-orders.kind: analytical teaching construction, not observed experimental data
analysis-derivative-orders.reader_question: The first derivative determines the tangent term; the second derivative corrects its quadratic error on the same function, point and signed steps.
analysis-derivative-orders.chapter_source: 03-mathematical-analysis.tex: 一元导数与局部变化率、二阶导数与曲率; common example requested by the author

parameters.color_roles: Blue exact function, red first-order approximant/remainder, yellow second-order approximant/remainder; colors remain consistent across panels.

analysis-derivative-orders.processing: Direct evaluation; no smoothing or random sampling. Discontinuous pieces are drawn separately.
